---
title: "Learn together. Build reproducible research."
---

Welcome to Donggyurim’s placement programme. This is a growing neuroimaging training and research guide for placement students supervised by Donggyurim. Each student learns from previous work and contributes improvements for the next cohort.

## Your first steps

1. Follow [Getting started](tutorials/getting-started.qmd).
2. Agree on a small research question and dataset with your supervisor.
3. Track your task in a GitHub issue and share work through a draft pull request.
4. Document the workflow and submit it for supervisor review.

## Explore the guide

- [Tutorials](tutorials/index.qmd): practical learning pathways.
- [Datasets](datasets/index.qmd): data access, provenance, and dataset limitations.
- [Techniques](techniques/index.qmd): methods, assumptions, and quality checks.
- [Student projects](projects/index.qmd): reproducible questions, findings, and lessons.

## Start a structural MRI project

The [supervised structural MRI pathway](tutorials/structural-mri-pathway.qmd) takes you from dataset selection to segmentation, analysis, figures, and handover. Lessons are teaching drafts awaiting practical validation. Your first milestone is one inspected scan, not an entire cohort.

Read [sources and contributions](sources-and-contributions.qmd) for acknowledgement of earlier placement work and our approach to permissions.
